title: Head of Engineering
description:

You will also focus on developing engineering talent, strengthening organizational capabilities, and driving continuous improvement.

* Lead and develop project engineering organization, including Technical Project Managers and engineering discipline leaders, ensuring clear accountability and effective technical execution.
* Establish engineering governance, quality gates, design reviews, systems engineering practices, and standardized processes across the project portfolio.
* Oversee engineering performance related to scope, schedule, cost, quality, technical risk, interfaces, and compliance with applicable standards and customer requirements.
* Partner with Project Management, Procurement, Field Operations, Commissioning, and suppliers to resolve technical challenges and deliver safe, constructible, and competitive solutions.
* Manage engineering workforce planning, skills demand, and competency development to ensure projects have the appropriate technical resources and expertise.
* Drive organizational development, capture lessons learned and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance engineering performance and project delivery.
